templates.AbyssalFiendEnfeebleAura: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.
templates.AbyssalFiendPunishmentAura: Curses all targets in an area, causing them to be debilitated when they hit enemies and increasing damage they take while on low life.
templates.AbyssalFiendTemporalChainsAura: Curses all enemies in an area, lowering their action speed and making other effects on them expire more slowly.
templates.Affliction: Permanently Afflicts any of your damageable minions in a targeted area, causing them to take physical damage over time, at an accelerating rate. Each such minion causes you to regenerate life at a rate based on the current damage of it's Affliction debuff. Afflicted Minions explode if their life is lowered to a fifth of maximum.
templates.AilmentBearer: Gain Unbound Fury by inflicting Elemental Ailments with Hits on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.
templates.AlchemistsMark: Curses a single enemy, granting flask charges when you hit them and creating Burning Ground under them if your hit Ignites them, and Caustic Ground if it Poisons them. Damage modifiers do not apply to these ground effects. You can only have one Mark at a time.
templates.Ambush: Teleports you to a nearby enemy, applying a buff to you for a short duration and blinding the enemy for a secondary duration. Performing a melee attack with a One-Handed Weapon removes the buff to exert that attack.
templates.AncestralCry: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent strike attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that  grants elemental resistances.
templates.Anger: Casts an aura that adds fire damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.
templates.AnimateGuardian: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area.
templates.AnimateGuardianAltX: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side using Smite of Divine Judgement, ignoring weapon restrictions. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area.
templates.AnimateGuardianSmite: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike a nearby enemy, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.AnimateGuardiansWeapon: Animates a copy of your Animated Guardian's main-hand weapon to fight by your side.
templates.AnimateWeapon: Animates a Melee Weapon Item or Lingering Blade to fight by your side. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines.
templates.AnimateWeaponAltX: Animates a copy of your main hand Melee Weapon to fight by your side. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps or Mines.
templates.AnimateWeaponAltY: Animates a Ranged Weapon Item or Lingering Blade to fight by your side. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines.
templates.AnimosityUniqueSkill: While active, this skill inflicts the Weeping Black debuff on impaled enemies you hit with bow attacks. Weeping Black deals physical damage over time, and can stack up to five times. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.
templates.ApproachingFlames: Become touched by the flames of the Cleansing Fire.
templates.Arc: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.
templates.ArcAltX: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and splits to simultaneously hit several other enemies.
templates.ArcAltY: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy, but this secondary arc cannot chain further.
templates.ArcaneCloak: Spends a portion of your mana to grant a buff that takes some of the damage from hits for you until depleted. The buff grants added lightning damage based on the amount of mana spent by this skill. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
templates.ArcticArmour: Conjures an icy barrier that chills enemies when they hit you. You drop chilled ground while moving, and take less Fire and Physical damage while stationary.
templates.ArmageddonBrand: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
templates.ArmageddonBrandAltX: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It activates once, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky, then is destroyed.
templates.ArmageddonBrandAltY: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
templates.ArtilleryBallista: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in a line, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.
templates.ArtilleryBallistaAltX: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in two perpendicular lines, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.
templates.ArtilleryBallistaAltY: Summons a ballista totem that propels a number of fiery arrows into the air, each targeting a specific enemy. Arrows deal area damage to enemies around it on landing. Requires a Bow.
templates.AspectOfArakaali: While active, you inflict Wither on hit, and Wither you inflict will be reflected back to you. Additionally, for each stack of Wither on you, your Life recovery rate is increased.
templates.AspectOfLunaris: While active, taking Physical or Elemental Damage will grant you either Lunar Protection or Lunar Resistance, respectively. Aspect of Lunaris lessens incoming Physical Damage for each Lunar Protection on you, and lessens incoming Elemental Damage for each Lunar Resistance on you. These buffs can both stack up to eight times.
templates.AspectOfSolaris: While active, inflicts Fire Exposure on enemies within its radius. Additionally, periodically applies a Sunscald debuff to enemies within its radius, with each Sunscald debuff increasing the effect of exposure on affected enemies. Sunscald can stack up to five times.
templates.AspectOfTheAvian: While active, grants the Avian's Might and Avian's Flight buffs in sequence. Avian's Might grants you and your minions a chance to deal Double Damage with hits for a duration. Avian's Flight grants you and your minions increased Movement Speed for a secondary duration.
templates.AspectOfTheBrineKing: While active, inflicts Chill on enemies within it's radius, while also increasing the strength of Chill you inflict and causing Damage you deal to Chilled enemies to penetrate some of their Cold Resistance.
templates.AspectOfTheCat: While active, grants the Cat's Stealth and Cat's Agility buffs in sequence. Cat's Stealth increases your critical strike chance, makes you harder to see, and gives you a chance to avoid damage for a short duration. Cat's Agility increases your attack and cast speed for a longer secondary duration.
templates.AspectOfTheCrab: While active, periodically adds Crab Barriers to you, and grants additional Physical Damage reduction for each Crab Barrier you have. All Crab Barriers are lost when you take physical damage from a hit.
templates.AspectOfTheSpider: While active, periodically applies a Spider's Web debuff to nearby Enemies, and Hinders them. Each Spider's Web on an Enemy increases the Damage they take. Hinder reduces their movement speed.
templates.AssassinsMark: Curses a single enemy, making them more vulnerable to Critical Strikes. Killing the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and a power charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.
templates.AtlasCrusaderJudgeBallLightning: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.
templates.AtlasCrusaderSisterMortarSpectre: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.AtlasEyrieArcherMortar: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.AtlasEyrieKiwethMortarSpectre: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.AtziriUniqueStaffFlameblast: Creates markers at your location and a targeted location, which grow over time based on cast speed, then explode, dealing fire damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.
templates.AtziriUniqueStaffStormCall: Creates a number of markers around the targeted location, which will explode after a duration, dealing lightning damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.
templates.Autoexertion: Reserves mana based on the supported warcries to cause those warcries to be repeatedly triggered.
templates.Automation: While this skill is active, supported spells will be repeatedly triggered.
templates.AvengingFlame: Launches a fiery projectile high into the air, to drop on a target and deal area damage where it lands.
templates.AxisCasterGlacialCascade: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.
templates.AxisDoubleStrikeTrigger: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.
templates.AxisEnfeeble: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.
templates.AxisTemporalChains: Curses all enemies in an area, lowering their action speed and making other effects on them expire more slowly.
templates.AzmeriAdmiralDashMortars: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.AzmeriAdmiralPrecision: Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies.
templates.AzmeriArgusMeleeAtAnimationSpeed: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.AzmeriBarrageDemonRainOfSpines: Fires a large number of arrows into the air, to land at the target after a short delay.
templates.AzmeriBarrageDemonSpinestorm: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
templates.AzmeriBasiliskShoulderMortar: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.AzmeriBasiliskShoulderMortar2: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.AzmeriBirdGrace: Casts an aura that grants evasion to you and your allies.
templates.AzmeriCasterDemonSpellDamageAura: Casts an aura that grants bonuses to damage and critical strike chance of spells to you and your allies, and gives a chance to create Consecrated Ground against stronger enemies.
templates.AzmeriCycloneDemonDesecratedGroundCyclon: Damage enemies around you, then perform a spinning series of attacks as you travel to a target location. Cannot be supported by Ruthless or Multistrike.
templates.AzmeriDemonPhysicalDamageAura: Casts an aura that causes nearby enemies to take more physical damage.
templates.AzmeriDoubleSlashAnimatedWeapon: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. The slashes will have a chance to inflict bleeding in Blood Stance, or have a wider angle in Sand Stance. Can be used with Axes and Swords. You are in Blood Stance by default.
templates.AzmeriDualStrikeDemonDualStrike: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.
templates.AzmeriFireFuryMoltenStrike: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land.
templates.AzmeriGeofriSmite: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike a nearby enemy, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.AzmeriGoddessDiscipline: Casts an aura that grants additional energy shield and increased energy shield recharge rate to you and your allies.
templates.AzmeriGolemLeapSlam: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
templates.AzmeriHailrakeArcticArmour: Conjures an icy barrier that chills enemies when they hit you. You drop chilled ground while moving, and take less Fire and Physical damage while stationary.
templates.AzmeriHailrakeGlacialCascade: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.
templates.AzmeriHailrakeGlacialHammer: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If a non-unique enemy is frozen and is on less than one third life, they will shatter when hit by Glacial Hammer. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will freeze enemies more easily. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
templates.AzmeriHydraHatred: Casts an aura that grants extra cold damage based on physical damage to you and your allies.
templates.AzmeriKudukuShockNova: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.
templates.AzmeriKudukuSparkExtraProj: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.
templates.AzmeriKudukuWarp: Waits for a duration before teleporting to a targeted destination, with the duration based on the distance and your movement speed. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the area around both where the player was and where they teleported to. Casting again will queue up multiple teleportations to occur in sequence.
templates.AzmeriKudukuWrath: Casts an aura that adds lightning damage to the attacks of you and your allies, and makes your spells deal more lightning damage.
templates.AzmeriLightningMelee: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.AzmeriMegaSkeletonCleave: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.AzmeriMegaSkeletonHeavyMelee: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.AzmeriOakLeapSlam: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
templates.AzmeriOakSweep: Swings a two handed mace or a staff in a circle, calling down holy hammers to land randomly on a number of enemies struck. Hits from these holy hammers cannot be evaded.
templates.AzmeriOakVitality: Casts an aura that grants life regeneration to you and your allies.
templates.AzmeriOversoulColdSnapTriggered: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.
templates.AzmeriOversoulRocksTriggered: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
templates.AzmeriPhantasmClarity: Casts an aura that grants mana regeneration to you and your allies.
templates.AzmeriReaperMelee: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.AzmeriSawbladeAnimatedWeaponCyclone: Damage enemies around you, then perform a spinning series of attacks as you travel to a target location. Cannot be supported by Ruthless or Multistrike.
templates.AzmeriTigerHaste: Casts an aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.
templates.AzmeriTurtleDetermination: Casts an aura that grants armour to you and your allies.
templates.AzmeriVikingCyclone: Damage enemies around you, then perform a spinning series of attacks as you travel to a target location. Cannot be supported by Ruthless or Multistrike.
templates.BallLightning: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.
templates.BallLightningAltX: Fires a single projectile which moves in a spiral while damaging each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.
templates.BallLightningAltY: Creates a ball of lightning at a location that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning. Cannot be supported by Spell Echo or used by Totems.
templates.BanditChampionBlastRainSpectre: Fires arrows up in the air, to rain down in an area. Each arrow deals area damage around where it lands, and they will all overlap on the targeted location.
templates.BanditExplosiveArrowAtAnimationSpeed: Fires an arrow which acts as a short duration fuse. Applying additional arrows to an enemy extends the duration. When the target dies or the fuses expire, the arrows explode, dealing fire AoE damage to nearby enemies. The AoE radius is proportional to the number of arrows upon death.
templates.Bane: Applies a debuff to enemies in an area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.BaneAltX: Applies a debuff to enemies in a small area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.Barkskin: Adopt the power of the forest, gradually covering your body in bark. Getting hit by enemy attacks causes bark to be removed. You take reduced damage from physical attack hits the more bark builds up, but higher chance to evade when less covered in bark.
templates.BarnacleSnap: Creates a giant barnacle that continually snaps at enemies, dealing off-hand area damage augmented by the defences of the shield. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which damage occurs.
templates.Barrage: After a short preparation time, you fire individual projectiles repeatedly with a Bow or Wand. These projectiles have a small randomised spread. This skill cannot be Triggered.
templates.BarrageAltX: After a short preparation time, you fire projectiles repeatedly with a Bow or Wand. These projectiles have a small randomised spread. This skill cannot be Triggered.
templates.BattlemagesCry: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that boosts critical strike chance.
templates.BearTrap: Throws a trap that damages and immobilises a single enemy for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. After the immobilise expires, a debuff remains on the enemy for a duration, lowering their movement speed by an amount which lessens over time. The affected enemy will take increased damage from traps and mines until the debuff expires. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.
templates.BearTrapAltX: Throws a trap that damages and impales a single enemy, and immobilises them for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.
templates.Berserk: Consumes Rage at an accelerating rate to increase the effects of Rage.
templates.BirdmanBloodProjectileMortar: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.BitingBraidNova: When hit, release a nova of venomous bile that deals spell chaos damage. This nova poisons and hinders on hit.
templates.BladeBlast: Deals spell damage in a targeted area. Each time this spell deals damage,  it will detonate any of your Lingering Blades it touches, dealing damage again in an area around them. Up to 50 Blades can be detonated this way.
templates.BladeBlastAltX: Deals spell damage in an area around you. If you have Blade Vortex blades orbiting you, it will detonate each of them in turn, dealing damage again in an area around you for each one.
templates.BladeBlastAltY: Deals spell damage in an area around you. Your equipped daggers add to this damage.
templates.BladeFlurry: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The damage is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.
templates.BladeFlurryAltX: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The critical strike chance is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.
templates.BladeTrap: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw or One Handed Sword around it in circles, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through.
templates.BladeTrapAltX: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Two Handed Sword around it in circles for a duration, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through
templates.BladeTrapAltY: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw, One Handed Sword or One Handed Axe around it in a circle, each damaging enemies it spins through.
templates.BladeVortex: This spell creates ethereal blades which orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius. As more blades are added, the damage becomes greater and more frequent.
templates.BladeVortexAltX: This spell creates a swarm of ethereal blades which briefly orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius.
templates.Bladefall: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.
templates.BladefallAltX: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys, each wider and more damaging than the last. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.
templates.BladefallAltY: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.
templates.BladefallAltZ: Once activated, continuously spends mana to cause volleys of ethereal weapons rain from the sky around you, dealing damage to enemies they impact. Each Blade will target a separate enemy in the volley area if possible. Each enemy can only be hit once by each volley, even if multiple blades land near them. This skill cannot be triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.Bladestorm: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a bladestorm matching your stance. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.
templates.BladestormAltX: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a random bladestorm. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe.
templates.BlastRain: Fires arrows up in the air, to rain down in an area. Each arrow deals area damage around where it lands, and they will all overlap on the targeted location.
templates.BlastRainAltX: Fires a single arrow up in the air, to rain down at a targeted location. The arrow deals area damage around where it lands, as well as releasing a wave of fire which will apply a burning debuff to enemies. The impact of the arrow will also inflict this debuff.
templates.BlazingSalvo: Fires projectiles which fly in an arc, dealing area damage on impact with either enemies or the ground near where you target. Targeting farther away causes the projectiles to spread out and land over a wider area.
templates.Blight: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.
templates.BlightAltX: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration. The damaging debuff is spread by Contagion.
templates.BlightAltY: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a longer secondary duration, slowing their movement and reducing their life regeneration rate. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.
templates.BlinkArrow: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.
templates.BlinkArrowAltX: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.
templates.BlinkArrowAltY: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.
templates.BlinkMirrorArrowMelee: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.BloodAndSand: Casts a buff that grants different bonuses to melee skills depending on your stance. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.
templates.BloodOffering: Consumes a corpse, and sacrifices a portion of your life, granting your minions life regeneration based on the life sacrificed, and a bonus to damage. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration and life regeneration for each corpse consumed.
templates.BloodRage: Adds a buff that deals Physical Damage over time, while increasing Attack Speed and Life Leech. Killing an enemy while this buff is active refreshes the buff duration, and can grant a Frenzy Charge.
templates.BloodSacramentUnique: Channel this skill to reserve more and more of your life, building up power in a marker on the ground under you. Release to deal physical damage in an area based on how much life you reserved. Cannot be cast by Totems.
templates.BloodShrineUniqueTriggeredExplodingToad: A toad spawns from the corpse of the slain enemy, leaps towards enemies and explodes, dealing forty percent of the slain enemy's Life as Chaos Damage. This skill's damage is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.
templates.Bodyswap: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or corpse, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise corpses over enemies. If targeting a corpse, the corpse will also explode, dealing damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.
templates.BodyswapAltX: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or damageable minion, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise minions over enemies. If targeting a minion, the minion will also be destroyed in an explosion which deals damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.
templates.BoneArmour: Applies a buff to you and each of your minions, which will take some of the damage from enemy hits before being depleted. The buff also grants immunity to bleeding. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
templates.BoneGolemLeapSlam: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
templates.BoneNova: Bones erupt around enemies you hit, dealing physical damage.
templates.BoneOffering: Consumes a corpse, granting all of your minions the power to block both attacks and spells. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.
templates.BoneStalkerEarthquake: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.Boneshatter: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.
templates.BoneshatterAltX: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.
templates.BoneshatterAltY: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.
templates.BrandRecall: Recall your brands to you, detaching them from enemies and increasing attachment range until they next attach to an enemy. Spends a portion of each recalled brand's cost to cause it to activate.
templates.BrandSupport: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, triggering linked spells. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
templates.Brandsurge: Overcharges your brands near the targeted area, causing them to accelerate how quickly they activate and expire. Deals damage in an area around each overcharged brand when it expires.
templates.BreachArc: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.
templates.BreachCleave: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.
templates.BreachHandTrap: Throws out a trap which creates a rift, attracting a malefic hand from another realm. When the trap is triggered, the hand tears the bottom of the breach out, shattering reality to deal spell damage in an area.
templates.BreachLightningWhip: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.
templates.BurningArrow: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.
templates.BurningArrowAltX: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.
templates.CageSpiderCycloneTriggerSandstorms: Damage enemies around you, then perform a spinning series of attacks as you travel to a target location. Cannot be supported by Ruthless or Multistrike.
templates.CageSpiderSandSpark: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.
templates.CallOfSteel: Calls impale debuffs from enemies, alive or dead, in a large area around you to gain steel shards. Deals reflected damage in a smaller area around each such enemy based on the impales removed from them. Continues to grant shards over time until you reach maximum or spend them.
templates.CatsStealthTriggeredIntimidatingCry: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants movement speed.
templates.CausticArrow: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.
templates.CausticArrowAltX: Fires a poisonous arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact.
templates.CeaselessFleshUnique: Once per second, raise a nearby corpse as a shambling undead. This minion will follow you and attack your enemies with melee strikes, but quickly falls apart. These minions have significantly increased attack speed while on low life.
templates.ChainHook: When used at range, throws out a chain, pulling you to the enemy hit dealing damage in an area behind them. When close to the enemy, just causes the area damage directly. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.
templates.ChainHookAltX: Cast your fishing rod towards a number of enemies in front of you. Non-unique enemies far away from you are pulled towards you.
templates.ChainHookAltY: Throws chains ahead of you, attaching them to targets hit. Enemies chained to you will grant rage when hit. When chains are broken, they snap and deal attack damage in an area around the target they were attached to. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.
templates.ChaosElementalCascadeSummoned: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.
templates.ChargedDash: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to teleport to the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.
templates.ChargedDashAltX: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to release the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.
templates.Clarity: Casts an aura that grants mana regeneration to you and your allies.
templates.Cleave: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.
templates.CleaveAltX: The character swings both their weapons in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Requires dual wielding both an Axe and a Sword.
templates.CobraLash: Fires a poisonous projectile based on your weapon that will chain between enemies. Requires a Dagger or Claw.
templates.ColdAegis: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes cold damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking cold damage from hits, or if depleted.
templates.ColdSnap: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.
templates.ColdSnapAltX: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.
templates.Combust: Deals attack damage in an area.
templates.Conductivity: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their lightning resistance and giving them a chance to be shocked when hit.
templates.Conflagration: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing area damage on impact and leaving the arrows stuck in the ground for a duration. If you move close to a stuck arrow, it will explode, dealing area damage and applying a fire damage over time debuff, as well as causing other stuck arrows in range to also explode.
templates.ConsecratedPath: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.ConsecratedPathAltX: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.Contagion: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies.
templates.ContagionAltX: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies, but each time it spreads, it only deals three quarters as much damage as before.
templates.ContagionAltY: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy is hit while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies.
templates.ConversionTrap: Throws a trap that, when triggered by an enemy, converts that enemy to your side for a short duration. Does not affect unique monsters or players.
templates.Convocation: Recalls all minions that are following you to your location, and grants them a temporary life regeneration effect.
templates.CorpseWalk: Spawns corpses around you while you move, based on monsters in the current area. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills.
templates.CorruptingFever: Draws out your own blood to power a buff for a duration, letting this skill inflict the Corrupting Blood debuff on enemies you hit, dealing physical damage over time for a short secondary duration. The buff's duration will be refreshed if you spend enough life before it expires.
templates.CracklingLance: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.
templates.CracklingLanceAltX: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.
templates.CracklingLanceAltY: Release a concentrated beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you.
templates.CreateFungalGroundOnKill: Creates a patch of Fungal Ground at the targeted location.
templates.CreepingFrost: Fire an icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.
templates.CreepingFrostAltX: Fire a single icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep rapidly across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.
templates.Cremation: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
templates.CremationAltX: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area and detonate nearby corpses for a duration. Corpse explosions are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
templates.CremationAltY: Creates a volcanic geyser at a location, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration.
templates.CrucibleIceStormTrap: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
templates.CrucibleVendigoFlickerStrike: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.
templates.CrushingFist: Retaliate against a blocked hit by calling forth a huge armoured fist to slam into the ground in front of you as you do the same, dealing weapon damage in an area.
templates.Cyclone: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.
templates.CycloneAltX: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.
templates.DancingDervishCycloneChannelled: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.
templates.DarkPact: This spell removes some life from one of your Skeleton minions near you or the targeted location to deal chaos damage in an area around it. This effect will chain to your other nearby skeletons. If you have no skeletons near you or the targeted location, it will sacrifice your own life to deal damage instead.
templates.DarkPactAltX: This spell deals chaos damage in an area around you. Casting this spell will cause you to gain Ruin. If this spell inflicts your seventh Ruin, it will sacrifice a large portion of your life to deal extra chaos damage based on the amount sacrificed, and remove all Ruin from you.
templates.Dash: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
templates.DeathAura: Casts an aura that deals Chaos Damage over Time to nearby Enemies. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.
templates.DeathWalk: While you walk, this skill causes corpses near your steps to explode, dealing fire damage in an area. The explosions of the corpses are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
templates.DeathWish: As you channel this spell, it spreads its effect to more of your minions. When you stop channelling, each affected minion explodes, and this skill deals spell damage around them.  The explosion of the minion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
templates.DecoyTotem: Summons a totem that taunts nearby monsters to attack it.
templates.DefianceBanner: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active.
templates.DelveMelee: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.DelveMeleeCold: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.DelveSpiderFlickerStrike: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.
templates.DemonModularBladeVortexSpectre: An ethereal blade spins around you for a duration, repeatedly damaging enemies that it passes through.
templates.Desecrate: Desecrates the ground, spawning corpses based on monsters in the current area and dealing chaos damage over time to enemies. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills.
templates.Despair: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their chaos resistance.
templates.DestructiveLink: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they use your main hand critical strike chance. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.Determination: Casts an aura that grants armour to you and your allies.
templates.DetonateDead: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.
templates.DetonateDeadAltX: Targets a corpse, causing it to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. Cannot target corpses that have been created by skills.
templates.DetonateDeadAltY: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with a shorter delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 8 corpses. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.
templates.DevouringTotem: Summons a totem that can consume nearby corpses. If you are hurt, it will destroy a corpse to leech life to you.
templates.Discharge: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.
templates.DischargeAltX: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.
templates.Discipline: Casts an aura that grants additional energy shield and increased energy shield recharge rate to you and your allies.
templates.DivineBlast: Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration, before blasting outwards in a larger and more damaging explosion.
templates.DivineBlastAltX: Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration as an orb, periodically releasing larger explosions. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which explosions occur.
templates.DivineIre: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a burst around you and a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect the beam. Maximum of 10 Stages.
templates.DivineIreAltX: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a powerful burst around you. Maximum of 10 Stages.
templates.DivineIreAltY: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages. Release to unleash this energy in a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect this skill. Maximum of 10 Stages.
templates.DivineRetribution: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a surge of divine power, causing multiple waves of lightning bursts to expand outward from a targeted location. This skill cannot be Triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.DominatingBlow: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.
templates.DominatingBlowAltX: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.
templates.DominatingBlowMinionCharge: Charges at a targeted location or enemy, pushing away enemies in your path and repeatedly dealing damage in a small area in front of you. You deal damage in a larger area when you reach the target. The further you travel, the more damage you deal, and the greater your chance of stunning enemies.
templates.DoomBlast: Deals chaos damage in an area.
templates.DoryanisTouch: The character uses their fist to slam the ground in front of them, with less attack speed, but more damage. This attack deals Lightning Damage to enemies in a large area, with a chance to Shock them. Cannot be used while wielding a Weapon. Cannot be Evaded.
templates.DoubleStrike: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.
templates.DoubleStrikeAltX: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.
templates.DoubleStrikeAltY: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon, gaining stages which cause this skill to attack faster. All stages are lost when you move.
templates.DreadBanner: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active.
templates.DropBearSummonedGroundSlam: The character slams the ground in front of them with a Staff, Mace or Sceptre, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun.
templates.DualStrike: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.
templates.DualStrikeAltX: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Requires dual-wielding two different melee weapon types to use.
templates.Earthquake: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.EarthquakeAltX: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.Earthshatter: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near any spike will cause them to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
templates.EarthshatterAltX: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. The spikes shatter after a duration, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
templates.EarthshatterAltY: Slam the ground, sending out a rectangular fissure that deals area damage to enemies and thrusts a large spike from the ground where it ends. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
templates.ElementalAegis: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes elemental damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking elemental damage from hits, or if depleted.
templates.ElementalHit: Each attack with a melee weapon will choose an element at random, and will only be able to deal damage of that element. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.
templates.ElementalHitAltX: Fires a projectile with a wand or bow that deals fire, cold and lightning damage. If the projectile hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them.

templates.Enfeeble: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.
templates.EnsnaringArrow: Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect.
templates.Envy: Casts an aura that adds chaos damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.
templates.EssenceDrain: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.
templates.EssenceDrainAltX: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You lose Life and Energy Shield equal to a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.
templates.EssenceDrainAltY: Fires a piercing projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage.
templates.EtherealKnives: Fires an arc of knives outwards in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
templates.EtherealKnivesAltX:
Fires an arc of knives down into the ground in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
Cannot be supported by Volley.
templates.EtherealKnivesAltY: Fires a circle of knives outwards around the caster which deal physical damage.
templates.Eviscerate: Retaliate against a blocked hit with an arcing slash that releases two waves of force. Enemies close in front of you can be hit by both waves. Requires a Sword or Axe and a Shield.
templates.ExplosiveArrow: Fires an arrow which will stick into an enemy or wall, and then explode, dealing area damage around it, either after a duration or when the maximum number of arrows stuck to that target is reached. If an enemy has multiple Explosive Arrows stuck in them, the first one to explode will consume the others, adding their damage to its explosion.
templates.ExplosiveConcoction: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.
templates.ExplosiveConcoctionAltX: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.
templates.ExplosiveTrap: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.
templates.ExplosiveTrapAltX: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.
templates.ExplosiveTrapAltY: Throws a trap that creates a large explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it.
templates.Exsanguinate: Releases several tendrils of blood from your character, targeting enemies in a narrow angle in front of you. The beams deal physical damage and inflict a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times. Effects which allow skills to chain can apply to these tendrils.
templates.ExsanguinateAltX: Releases a tendril of blood from your character, which will target an enemy in front of you, then chain to other enemies. The tendril deals physical damage and inflicts a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times.
templates.EyeOfWinter: Fires a single eye projectile which constantly releases shard projectiles in a spiral. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a faster spiral of extra shards.
templates.EyeOfWinterAltX: Fires a single eye projectile which cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a fast spiral of shards. The shards will deal cold damage to enemies they impact.
templates.EyeOfWinterAltY: Fires a single eye projectile which releases a number shard projectiles in a spiral before dissipating. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies.
templates.FaridunCasterUndeadDamageOverTimeAura: Casts an aura that multiplies damage over time and increases skill effect duration of you and your allies.
templates.FemaleCannibalBossFireStorm: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
templates.FemaleCannibalBossFlameDash: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
templates.FieryImpactHeistMaceImplicit: Deals attack damage in an area.
templates.FireAegis: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes fire damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking fire damage from hits, or if depleted.
templates.FireBurstOnHit: A burst of flame errupts from the location of a hit, dealing fire damage.
templates.FireElementalFlameRedSummoned: Summons a totem that fires a stream of flame at nearby enemies.
templates.FireElementalMortarSummoned: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.FireMonsterWhirlingBlades: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. If dual wielding attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one hit. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.
templates.FireTrap: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving an area of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through it.
templates.FireTrapAltX: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.
templates.Fireball: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.
templates.FireballIncursionChaos: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

templates.Firestorm: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
templates.FirestormAltX: A large flaming bolt falls towards the targeted area. The bolt explodes when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
templates.FirestormAltY: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
templates.FlameDash: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
templates.FlameDashAltY: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground, then repeat the teleport in the other direction. Cannot be triggered, or used by a totem, trap or mine. Cannot be supported by Unleash.
templates.FlameLink: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they deal additional fire damage based on your life. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.FlameSurge: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.
templates.FlameSurgeAltX: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. If this ignites an enemy a large area of burning ground will be created under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.
templates.FlameWall: Create a wall of fire for a duration, which deals burning damage to everything in its area. Each enemy that enters the wall also receives a secondary burning debuff which persists for a short duration after leaving the wall. Any projectiles fired through the wall by you and allies deal added fire damage and apply the wall's secondary debuff on hit.
templates.FlamebearerFlameBlue: Summons a totem that fires a stream of flame at nearby enemies.
templates.Flameblast: Channels to build up a large explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.
templates.FlameblastAltX: Channels to build up an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill or automatically at maximum stages. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.
templates.FlameblastAltY: Channels to concentrate an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the damage of the explosion, but the smaller the area.
templates.FlamethrowerTrap: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration, rotating around the trap and repeatedly dealing damage. Burning enemies are dealt more damage.
templates.FlamethrowerTrapAltX: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration repeatedly dealing damage.
templates.Flammability: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their fire resistance and giving them a chance to be ignited when hit.
templates.FleshAndStone: Buffs you, and affects nearby enemies with an aura, differently depending on your stance. Both stances are more impactful against enemies closer to you. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.
templates.FleshOffering: Consumes a corpse, which temporarily empowers your minions with swiftness. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.
templates.FlickerStrike: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.
templates.FlickerStrikeAltX: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.
templates.Focus: Focus your power, granting yourself the Focused buff.
templates.FogOfWar: Creates a Smoke Cloud in an area, which blinds enemies within it.
templates.ForbiddenRite: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your life and energy shield. Casting this spell damages you.
templates.ForbiddenRiteAltX: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your energy shield. Casting this spell damages you.
templates.FreezingPulse: An icy projectile which has a chance to freeze enemies it passes through. The projectile fades quickly, reducing damage and freezing chance until it dissipates.
templates.Frenzy: Performs an attack with a ranged weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.
templates.FrenzyAltX: Perform a strike with a melee weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.
templates.FrostBlades: Attack enemies with increased range, releasing icy blades from the first enemy hit which fly at other enemies. Requires a Melee Weapon.
templates.FrostBladesAltX: Attack enemies with greatly increased range, creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time if it hits. Requires a Melee Weapon.
templates.FrostBolt: Fires a slow-moving projectile that pierces through enemies, dealing cold damage.
templates.FrostBomb: Creates a crystal that pulses with cold for a duration. Each pulse applies a debuff to nearby enemies for a secondary duration which reduces life regeneration rate, and also inflicts Cold Exposure. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.
templates.FrostBombAltX: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing cold damage to enemies around it.
templates.FrostBombAltY: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.
templates.FrostShield: Place a Frost Shield that drains your energy shield for one second or until you run out, gaining stages while this drain occurs. The Frost Shield takes some damage from hits in place of you and allies while in its area. Enemies in the area are Chilled. You can only have one Frost Shield active at once.
templates.FrostWall: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back.
templates.Frostbite: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their cold resistance and giving them a chance to be frozen when hit.
templates.Frostblink: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving Chilled ground in an area at both ends of the teleport. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
templates.FrostblinkAltX: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies in an area at both ends of the teleport. Deals higher damage to chilled enemies, then removes chill from them. Cannot be supported by Unleash.
templates.FrozenLegion: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.FrozenLegionAltX: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.FrozenSweep: This attack is used by your Statues to deal damage in an area around them while stepping forward. This skill cannot repeat and can only be used by Statues from Frozen Legion.
templates.FrozenSweepAltX: This attack is used by your Statues to deal damage in an area around them while stepping forward. This skill cannot repeat and can only be used by Statues from Frozen Legion.
templates.GalvanicArrow: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. The arrows are fired with such force that they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.
templates.GalvanicArrowAltX: Create a burst of lightning from your Bow, firing no arrows but damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.
templates.GalvanicArrowAltY: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. If the arrows' flight is stopped by colliding with a target, they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone behind the target
templates.GalvanicField: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning. The strength of the field depends on the magnitude of shock affecting the enemy when it is created.
templates.GalvanicFieldAltX: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning.
templates.GemDetonateMines: Detonates a Mine, starting a Detonation Sequence which will detonate other Mines around it.
templates.GeneralsCry: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user, and summoning Mirage Warriors from nearby corpses. The Mirage Warriors each use a linked attack skill once before dissipating.
templates.GhostCannons: Manifest a row of Ghostly Cannons, each of which then fires after a short delay dealing the damage of the weapon that triggered it. For each additional projectile this skill would fire, create an additional Ghostly Cannon instead.
templates.GhostPirateBladeVortexSpectre: An ethereal blade spins around you for a duration, repeatedly damaging enemies that it passes through.
templates.GlacialCascade: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area and knocking them back in the direction of the next burst.
templates.GlacialCascadeAltX: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.
templates.GlacialHammer: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If a non-unique enemy is frozen and is on less than one third life, they will shatter when hit by Glacial Hammer. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will freeze enemies more easily. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
templates.GlacialHammerAltX: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will be a critical strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
templates.GlacialShieldSwipe: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of ice in a cone in front of you.
templates.GluttonyOfElements: Casts an aura that causes taking elemental damage to heal you and nearby allies instead.
templates.GoatmanEarthquake: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.GoatmanFireMagmaOrb: Lob a fiery orb that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times.
templates.GoatmanMoltenShell: Summons fiery elemental shields providing additional armour for a short duration. If cumulative physical damage prevented by your blocking or armour reaches a threshold, the shields explode outwards, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.
templates.GoreShockwave: Deals attack damage in an area.
templates.Grace: Casts an aura that grants evasion to you and your allies.
templates.GroundSlam: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.GroundSlamAltX: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wide wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. Requires a Two Handed Axe, Two Handed Mace, or Staff.
templates.GuardianArc: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.
templates.HalfSkeletonPuncture: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with bows, daggers, claws or swords.
templates.HarvestRhexLeapSlam: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
templates.Haste: Casts an aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.
templates.Hatred: Casts an aura that grants extra cold damage based on physical damage to you and your allies.
templates.HeavyStrike: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Sword or Staff.
templates.HeavyStrikeAltY: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Staff.
templates.HeistCultistUnarmedLeap: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. If dual wielding attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one hit. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.
templates.HeistProjectUnarmedMelee1: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.HeistThugRangedExplosiveArrow: Fires an arrow which will stick into an enemy or wall, and then explode, dealing area damage around it, either after a duration or when the maximum number of arrows stuck to that target is reached. If an enemy has multiple Explosive Arrows stuck in them, the first one to explode will consume the others, adding their damage to its explosion.
templates.HellscapeFleshFodderArc: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.
templates.HeraldOfAgony: Grants a buff giving more poison damage and a chance to inflict poison. When you poison an enemy while you have this buff, you gain Virulence, and summon an Agony Crawler minion that uses projectile and area attacks. You will lose Virulence over time, at a rate which increases the more Virulence you have. The minion will die when you have no Virulence.
templates.HeraldOfAgonyMinionCleave: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.
templates.HeraldOfAgonyMinionMortar: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.HeraldOfAsh: Grants a buff providing fire damage based on your physical damage. While you have this buff, if you kill an enemy, other enemies near them will be burned based on the overkill damage. The burn inflicted by this skill can only be affected by modifiers to damage over time (burning damage is damage over time).
templates.HeraldOfIce: Grants a buff adding cold damage to spells and attacks. If you shatter an enemy, this skill will cause them to explode and deal AoE cold damage to enemies near them. This damage is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.
templates.HeraldOfPurity: Grants a buff which lets you deal more physical damage. When you kill an enemy while you have this buff, this skill will summon a Sentinel of Purity, or refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them. The Sentinels of Purity have a single-target melee attack and an area melee attack.
templates.HeraldOfTheBreach: Grants a buff which causes you to deal more damage for each Herald skill affecting you. While you have this buff, this skill turns the space around you into a tear in reality, releasing pulses that damage enemies around you. Inflicting Ailments causes you to gain Otherworldly Pressure, which increases the frequency of the pulses. You will lose Otherworldly Pressure over time, at a rate which increases the more of it you have. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.
templates.HeraldOfThunder: Grants a buff which adds lightning damage to spells and attacks. If you kill a shocked enemy, this skill will create a storm, causing lightning bolts to strike enemies around you for a duration. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.
templates.Hexblast: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way.
templates.HexblastAltX: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way.
templates.HexblastAltY: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target.
templates.HolyFireElementalFireball: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.
templates.HolyFlameTotem: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem.
templates.HolyFlameTotemAltX: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem.
templates.HolyHammers: Slam the ground, calling down a Holy Hammer from above. On hitting an enemy, another Hammer will cascade forward, repeating if further enemies are hit, up to a cap. A Power Charge can be expended to call down additional Hammers to either side of the initial slam. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
templates.HolyHammersAltX: Slam the ground, consuming all Power Charges and calling down a cascade of holy hammers from above in an outward spiral. Further hammers are called down for each Power Charge consumed. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
templates.HolyStrike: Infuse your weapon with holy energy and swing. Successfully hitting an enemy will summon forth a copy of your Main Hand weapon as a Holy Armament. These Holy Armaments are undamageable minions, and will attack the enemies you target with Holy Strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
templates.HolyStrikeMinionAttack: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.Hydrosphere: Create a sphere of water, or move an existing sphere and reset its duration. The sphere continually applies a drenched debuff with a short duration to enemies in its area or those it moves through.
