You can hit the sphere with other skills to inflict Cold and Lightning Ailments (other than Chill). The sphere pulses when created, at regular intervals while afflicted by an Ailment, and after moving, damaging all drenched enemies in a large area.
templates.IceCrash: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area around the impact in three stages of increasing size. Enemies take slightly less damage on the second and third stage, and can only be hit by one stage. Works with Swords, Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
templates.IceCrashAltX: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area. Slams with main hand weapon deal more damage. Slams with off hand weapon have larger area of effect. Requires dual-wielding Swords, Maces, Sceptres, or Axes to use.
templates.IceCrashAzmeriHailrake: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area around the impact in three stages of increasing size. Enemies take slightly less damage on the second and third stage, and can only be hit by one stage. Works with Swords, Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
templates.IceElementalIceCyclone: Damage enemies around you, then perform a spinning series of attacks as you travel to a target location. Cannot be supported by Ruthless or Multistrike.
templates.IceNova: A circle of ice expands from the caster.
templates.IceNovaAltX: A circle of ice expands from the caster. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will expand from a number of those projectiles instead. If this skill would repeat when cast this way, it will instead expand again from the same projectiles after a short delay.
templates.IceNovaAltY: A circle of ice expands from the caster.
templates.IceShot: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target.
templates.IceShotAltX: Fires a piercing arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in two cones perpendicular to the target.
templates.IceSpear: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.
templates.IceSpearAltX: Launches a shard of ice that splits on hitting terrain or enemies. After splitting, the projectiles are in second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.
templates.IceTrap: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.
templates.IceTrapAltX: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions in a circle around itself when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.
templates.Icestorm: Icy bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies and chilling them, as well as causing patches of chilled ground. Skill damage is based on Intelligence.
templates.IcicleBurst: This attack fires icy projectiles in a circle around enemies you hit, dealing attack damage with all physical damage converted to cold.
templates.IcicleMine: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.
templates.IcicleMineAltX: Throws a mine that fires projectiles at enemies when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.
templates.IcicleMineAltY: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.
templates.IllusoryWarp: Teleport to a target destination. Chilled ground is spread in an area around both where the caster was and where they teleported to.
templates.ImmortalCall: Take less Physical and Elemental Damage for a short time. Consumes up to 5 Endurance Charges to lengthen the buff and further lessen Physical Damage taken. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
templates.Incinerate: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a wave of fire damage over a wide and long area that will apply a powerful Ignite.
templates.IncinerateAltX: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a slow-moving wave of fire damage over a very large area that will apply a powerful Ignite.
templates.IncinerateAltY: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you.
templates.IncursionLeapSlamChampion: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
templates.InfernalBlow: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to enemies hit by your strike, and an uncharged debuff to any other enemies hit. Upon reaching 6 charges, expiring, or the enemy's death, the charged debuff is removed to damage that and other surrounding enemies. Enemies with either debuff explode when they die, damaging other surrounding enemies. Damage from this explosion cannot be reflected. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.InfernalBlowAltX: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to you the first time you hit an enemy with this skill. Upon reaching 6 charges, or charges expiring, the charged debuff is removed to damage nearby enemies. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.InfernalCry: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants a portion of their physical damage as extra fire damage. In addition to being taunted, enemies are inflicted with a secondary debuff causing them to explode when they die, dealing fire damage in an area.
templates.IntimidatingCry: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants movement speed.
templates.IntuitiveLink: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, their hits can trigger your supported spells. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.KaomFireBeamTotemSpectre: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Inflicts Fire Exposure at maximum stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.
templates.KaomWarriorMoltenStrike: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land.
templates.KineticBlast: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies.
templates.KineticBlastAltX: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies.
templates.KineticBolt: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from.
templates.KineticBoltAltX: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from. Multiple of these projectiles can hit the same target.
templates.KineticFusillade: Wave your wand to create a hovering kinetic projectile. After a short duration, the projectile is fired at an enemy, dealing area damage on impact and chaining to further targets. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Multiple projectiles fired in sequence will attempt to target different enemies. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines.
templates.KineticFusilladeAltX: Wave your wand to create multiple hovering kinetic projectiles. After a short duration, the projectiles explode, dealing area damage. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines.
templates.KineticRain: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage and triggering Kinetic Anomaly. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.KineticRainAltX: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage.
templates.KineticRainKineticInstability: Gathers kinetic energy into an anomaly at the targeted location, which will explode when enemies are near it, dealing your wand's damage in an area. The anomaly will dissipate after a duration.
templates.KitavaDemonCleave: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.
templates.KitavaDemonLeapSlam: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
templates.KitavaDemonWhirlingBlades: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. If dual wielding attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one hit. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.
templates.KitavaSlavedriverFlameWhip: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.
templates.Lacerate: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. The slashes will have a chance to inflict bleeding in Blood Stance, or have a wider angle in Sand Stance. Can be used with Axes and Swords. You are in Blood Stance by default.
templates.LacerateAltX: Slashes twice, releasing wide waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a Two Handed Axe or Two Handed Sword.
templates.LacerateAltY: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a One Handed Axe or One Handed Sword.
templates.LancingSteel: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward, consuming your Steel Shards to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.
templates.LancingSteelAltX: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it.
templates.LeapSlam: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
templates.LeapSlamAltX: Jump a short distance through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
templates.LegionKaruiMeleeLeapSlam: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
templates.LegionTemplarJudgeBallLightning: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.
templates.LegionTemplarJudgeStormCall: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it and causing lightning strikes at any other markers you've cast.
templates.LightningAegis: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes lightning damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking lightning damage from hits, or if depleted.
templates.LightningArrow: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies.
templates.LightningArrowAltX: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning. It sticks into the final target, causing them to be struck and damaged multiple times.
templates.LightningBolt: A bolt of lightning strikes an area, dealing lightning damage.
templates.LightningConduit: Lightning strikes all Shocked enemies around a targeted location, then removes Shock from those enemies. Shocks cannot expire on enemies in range while casting this spell. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade or Unleash.
templates.LightningConduitAltX: Lightning strikes a number of enemies around a targeted location. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.
templates.LightningSpireTrap: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.
templates.LightningSpireTrapAltX: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.
templates.LightningSpireTrapAltY: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.
templates.LightningStrike: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as projectiles as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies. The projectiles cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target.
templates.LightningStrikeAltX: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as a projectile as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies and chain between them. The projectile cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target.
templates.LightningTendrils: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you.
templates.LightningTendrilsAltX: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you.
templates.LightningTendrilsAltY: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a growing semicircular area in front of you.
templates.LightningTrap: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.
templates.LightningTrapAltX: Throws a trap that launches projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.
templates.LightningWarp: Waits for a duration before teleporting to a targeted destination, with the duration based on the distance and your movement speed. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the area around both where the player was and where they teleported to. Casting again will queue up multiple teleportations to occur in sequence.
templates.MMSAzmeriDemonBloodVomitLarge: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.MMSAzmeriDemonBloodVomitMedium: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.MMSAzmeriDemonBloodVomitSmall: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.MMSAzmeriShepherdTripleMortar: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.MMSAzmeriShepherdVomitMortar: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.MMSHeistRobotClockworkGolemMortarSpectre: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.MMSHellscapeDemonEliteTripleMortar: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.MMSHellscapeDemonEliteVomitMortar: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.MMSPyromaniacIceMortar: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.Malevolence: Casts an aura that multiplies damage over time and increases skill effect duration of you and your allies.
templates.ManaInfusedStaff: Infuses your staff with arcane energy, lowering your mana costs and increasing your chance to block. When you block, you release an arcane wave, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration.
templates.Manabond: Deals lightning damage based upon your missing mana in a circular area around the targeted location, as well as in four rectangular extensions whose lengths depend upon your remaining mana.
templates.ManifestDancingDervishes: Manifests two Dancing Dervishes to fight by your side. While a Dancing Dervish is manifested, you have Onslaught and cannot use Weapons. Cannot be supported by supports that would create other minions.
templates.Melee: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeAtAnimationSpeed: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeAtAnimationSpeedChaos: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeAtAnimationSpeedCold: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeAtAnimationSpeedFire: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeAtAnimationSpeedLightning: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeAtAnimationSpeedUnique: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeCold: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeComboCold: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeEyrieArrow: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeEyrieBird: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeFire: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeKaruiArcher: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleePartialChaos: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MeleeUseContactPoint: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.MirrorArrow: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.
templates.MirrorArrowAltX: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.
templates.MirrorArrowAltY: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.
templates.MistyReflection: Dash backwards, leaving a short-lived mist copy of yourself that Taunts nearby Enemies for a short duration. The copy can be damaged by Enemies, and copies that are killed by an Enemy will apply a debuff in an area that makes affected targets take 30% increased Damage and deal 30% less Damage for 4 seconds.
templates.MoltenShell: Applies a buff that adds to your armour, and can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. When the buff expires or is depleted, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken from the buff. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
templates.MoltenStrike: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land.
templates.MoltenStrikeAltX: Infuses your two-handed melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land. Every fifth time you attack with this skill it fires more, high-damage projectiles.
templates.MonsterArc: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.
templates.MonsterCausticArrow: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.
templates.MonsterCausticArrowAtAnimationSpeed: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.
templates.MonsterDischarge: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.
templates.MonsterEnduringCry: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and granting a buff to the user and nearby allies. The user and allied players also gain endurance charges.
templates.MonsterFireBomb: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving an area of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through it.
templates.MonsterFireballContactPos: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.
templates.MonsterFlameRedCannibal: Summons a totem that fires a stream of flame at nearby enemies.
templates.MonsterFlickerStrike: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.
templates.MonsterIceShot: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target.
templates.MonsterLeapSlam: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
templates.MonsterLeapSlamFoothills: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
templates.MonsterLesserMultiFireballSpectre: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.
templates.MonsterLesserMultiIceSpear: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.
templates.MonsterLightningArrow: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies.
templates.MonsterMultiFireballSpectre: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.
templates.MonsterMultiIceSpear: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.
templates.MonsterProjectileWeakness: Curses a single enemy, increasing the damage they take from projectiles, and making projectiles split when hitting them, to hit other targets around them. You can only have one Mark at a time.
templates.MonsterPuncture: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with bows, daggers, claws or swords.
templates.MonsterRighteousFireWhileSpectred: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your spell damage is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining.
templates.MonsterShockNova: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.
templates.MonsterSpark: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.
templates.MonsterSplitFireballSpectre: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.
templates.MonsterSplitIceSpear: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.
templates.MonsterViperStrike: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, will strike with both weapons. Requires a claw, dagger or sword.
templates.MonsterViperStrikeAtAnimationSpeed: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, will strike with both weapons. Requires a claw, dagger or sword.
templates.MonsterWarlordsMark: Curses a single enemy, giving a chance to double the duration of stuns on them. Attacking the cursed enemy will leech life and mana, stunning them will grant rage, and killing it will grant an endurance charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.
templates.MotherOfFlamesMagmaOrb3: Lob a fiery orb that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times.
templates.MountainGoatmanIceSpear: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.
templates.NecromancerConductivity: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their lightning resistance and giving them a chance to be shocked when hit.
templates.NecromancerElementalWeakness: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their elemental resistances.
templates.NecromancerEnfeeble: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.
templates.NecromancerFlammability: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their fire resistance and giving them a chance to be ignited when hit.
templates.NecromancerFrostbite: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their cold resistance and giving them a chance to be frozen when hit.
templates.NecromancerProjectileWeakness: Curses a single enemy, increasing the damage they take from projectiles, and making projectiles split when hitting them, to hit other targets around them. You can only have one Mark at a time.
templates.NecromancerRaiseZombie: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike.
templates.NecromancerVulnerability: Curse all targets in an area, causing them to take increased physical damage. Attacks against the cursed enemies have a chance to inflict bleeding.
templates.OrbOfStorms: Creates a stationary electrical orb that strikes enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning that can then split to hit more enemies. Modifiers to cast speed will increase how frequently it does this. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.
templates.OrbOfStormsAltX: Creates an electrical orb that will strike enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning when placed, as well as when you use a lightning skill while within its area. These beams of lightning can then split to hit more enemies. When striking enemies, this orb will teleport to a random enemy struck. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.
templates.Pacify: Curses all targets in an area, having no effect at first, but causing them to deal no damage once 60% of the curse's duration has expired.
templates.PenanceBrand: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy. When the branded enemy reaches 20 energy, a large explosion occurs and the brand is removed. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.
templates.PenanceBrandAltX: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and causing a pulse that deals damage to the branded enemy and other nearby enemies. The pulse gains area of effect and damage for each energy on the branded enemy, up to 20. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.
templates.PenanceBrandAltY: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and nearby enemies who do not have energy. When the brand is detached, all enemies with energy are dealt damage.
templates.PenanceMark: Curses a single enemy, causing them to spawn multiple phantasms when hit. The phantasms will be allies of the marked enemy with the same monster level. They cast a projectile spell which deals physical damage, and are immune to curses and knockback. You can only have one Mark at a time.
templates.Perforate: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.
templates.PerforateAltX: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.
templates.PerforateAltY:
Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spikes from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times.
Requires a Sword or Axe.
templates.PestilentStrike: Attacks with your weapon, inflicting a debuff on enemies hit by the strike. If a debuffed enemy dies while poisoned, Pestilent Strike inflicts a secondary chaos damage over time debuff on enemies around them, based on the poisons on the slain enemy. This damage is not affected by your damage modifiers. Requires a Claw or Dagger.
templates.PetrifiedBlood: Applies a buff that protects the lower half of your life, preventing some of the immediate life loss when damaged by hits and applying the loss over time instead. Your life cannot be raised above low life other than by flasks, and while above low life, skills will cost life as well as mana.
templates.PhaseRun: Gain a buff that makes you faster, harder to detect, and grants Phasing, letting you pass through enemies. Performing any skill replaces this buff with one that boosts melee physical damage of skills you use yourself (it will not apply to your melee skills used by totems). Consumes Frenzy Charges to increase duration.
templates.PhysicalAegis: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes physical damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking physical damage from hits, or if depleted.
templates.PlagueBearer: Gain an Incubating buff, adding to its Plague Value as you inflict poisons. Use the skill again to begin Infecting, dealing chaos damage over time to nearby enemies until the Plague Value is depleted. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this skill's damage. Using the skill again alternates between Incubating and Infecting.
templates.PoachersMark: Curses a single enemy, lowering their physical damage reduction, and adding physical damage to all hits against them. Attacking the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and killing them will grant a frenzy charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.
templates.PoisonousConcoction: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area and has a chance to poison. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.
templates.PoisonousConcoctionAltX: Throws a single bottle that releases a burst when it hits the ground, dealing unarmed attack damage in an area with a chance to poison. The skill chains, bouncing randomly to deal damage multiple times. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.
templates.Portal: Creates a portal to the current area's town.
templates.PowerSiphon: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.
templates.PowerSiphonAltX: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.
templates.Precision: Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies.
templates.Pride: Casts an aura that causes nearby enemies to take more physical damage.
templates.PrimalAegis: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes elemental damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking elemental damage from hits, or if depleted.
templates.PrismaticBurst: Chooses an element at random and deals damage of that type in an area. Having higher strength makes it more likely to choose fire, higher dexterity makes it more likely to choose cold, and higher intelligence makes it more likely to choose lightning.
templates.ProtectiveLink: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they copy your block chance and recover life when they block. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.Puncture: Punctures enemies with your Bow, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration.
templates.PunctureAltX: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with daggers, claws or swords.
templates.Punishment: Curses all targets in an area, causing them to be debilitated when they hit enemies and increasing damage they take while on low life.
templates.PurifyingFlame: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit.
templates.PurifyingFlameAltX: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit.
templates.PurityOfElements: Casts an aura that grants elemental resistances and elemental ailment immunity to you and your allies.
templates.PurityOfFire: Casts an aura that grants fire resistance to you and your allies.
templates.PurityOfIce: Casts an aura that grants cold resistance to you and your allies.
templates.PurityOfLightning: Casts an aura that grants lightning resistance to you and your allies.
templates.PyroChaosFireball: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.
templates.PyroFireball: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.
templates.PyroclastMine: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies.
templates.PyroclastMineAltX: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies.
templates.QueensDemand: Alternates triggering Flames of Judgement and Storm of Judgement
templates.QuickGuard: Applies a buff which can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
templates.QuickstepHardMode: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location, stopping if you would overlap with monsters or terrain. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. Cannot be supported.
templates.RageVortex: Spin with a sword or axe to deal damage in an area around you. Sacrifices some rage to send a ragestorm forward. While enemies are inside it, the ragestorm will slow its movement and repeatedly deal attack damage based on your attack speed.
templates.RageVortexAltX: Spin with a sword or axe to deal damage in an area around you. If you have at least 10 rage, create a ragestorm attached to you that repeatedly deals attack damage to enemies inside based on your attack speed. The ragestorm consumes rage at an accelerating rate, and ends if you run out.
templates.RagingSpiritMeleeAttack: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.RainOfArrows: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.
templates.RainOfArrowsAltX: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting in front of you and proceeding in a line in the direction of the target. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it.
templates.RainOfArrowsAltY: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to slowly land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.
templates.RainOfArrowsCloneShot: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.
templates.RaiseSpectre: Raises a spectral version of a defeated foe as a minion to fight for you in battle.
templates.RaiseSpectreAltX: Raises a spectral version of a defeated foe as a temporary minion to fight for you in battle for a duration.
templates.RaiseSpiders: Raise two spectral spiders from each nearby corpse that will attack your enemies with Viper Strike. Each raised spider grants you increased Attack Speed and increased Damage with Poison. Enemies will not engage the spiders directly, and they are immune to damage.
templates.RaiseZombie: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike.
templates.RaiseZombieAltX: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike and an area of effect slam.
templates.RaiseZombieAltY: Raises necromantic energies into the sky above a targeted location, where they coalesce into a zombie minion. The minion then attacks by falling to the ground, causing an impact that deals damage in an area. The zombie cannot survive the impact.
templates.RallyingCry: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. Nearby allies gain a buff based on the damage of your weapon.
templates.Ravenous: Consumes a targeted corpse, granting you a buff that gives you bonuses against enemies of the same monster category as the corpse.
templates.Reap: A bloody scythe swipes across a selected area, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges.
templates.ReapAltX: A bloody scythe swipes around you, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges.
templates.Reave: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.
templates.ReaveAltX: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.
templates.RejuvenationTotem: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies.
templates.RepeatingShockwave: While you run, this skill creates a small explosion with each step, dealing fire damage in an area around you.
templates.ResentmentUniqueSkill: While active, your bow attacks inflict Cinderflame. Cinderflame deals fire damage over time, and can stack up to ten times. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.
templates.RighteousFire: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your spell damage is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining.
templates.RighteousFireAltX: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your cast speed is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining. Requires mana.
templates.RockGolemMinionWhirlingBlades: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. If dual wielding attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one hit. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.
templates.RollingMagma: Lob a fiery orb that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times.
templates.RuneBlast: Channel to improve runes placed by Stormbind based on the mana you spend channelling this skill. Release to detonate the targeted rune, which will cause other runes to detonate in a chain reaction.
templates.RuneBlastAltX: Channel to improve runes placed by Stormbind based on the mana you spend channelling this skill. Release to detonate the targeted rune, which will cause other runes to detonate in a chain reaction. Detonation can teleport you to the targeted Rune.
templates.ScorchingRay: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Inflicts Fire Exposure at maximum stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.
templates.ScorchingRayAltX: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.
templates.ScourgeArrow: Channel to infuse an arrow with chaos, gaining stages while it is held. Release to fire it, leaving spore pods in its wake. Each spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, and the spore pods will be divided between those arrows.
templates.ScourgeArrowAltX: Fire an arrow that leaves a spore pod in its wake. The spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, each of which leaves its own spore pod.
templates.SearingBond: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage.
templates.SearingBondAltX: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage. Reaching maximum active totem count will cause all totems from this skill to detonate, applying the same burning damage for a duration.
templates.SeawitchFrostbolt: Fires a slow-moving projectile that pierces through enemies, dealing cold damage.
templates.SeawitchVulnerability: Curse all targets in an area, causing them to take increased physical damage. Attacks against the cursed enemies have a chance to inflict bleeding.
templates.SecretDesecrateMonsterEarthquakeTriggere: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.SeismicCry: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent slam attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that increases their armour and stun threshold.
templates.SeismicTrap: Throws a trap which, once triggered, repeatedly releases a number of waves for a duration. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst.
templates.SeismicTrapAltX: Throws a trap which, once triggered, releases a number of waves. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst.
templates.ShadeForm: Makes you immune to physical damage, and harder for enemies to detect, for a duration.
templates.ShaperApparitionBeam: Shaper's Memory casts this spell for you to fire a damaging beam for a duration that deals damage over time to things in it.
templates.ShaperApparitionProjectiles: Shaper's Memory casts this spell for you to fire piercing projectiles in front of you that deal cold damage.
templates.ShaperApparitionTeleportSlam: Shaper's Memory uses this attack for you to teleport to an enemy and attack with a powerful blow, dealing area damage based on your weapon.
templates.ShatteringSteel: Swing an Axe or Sword, firing projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter.
templates.ShatteringSteelAltX: Swing an Axe or Sword, consuming Steel Shards to gain a Steel Ward that protects you for a duration, and fire projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.
templates.ShieldCharge: Charges at a targeted location or enemy, pushing away enemies in your path and repeatedly dealing off-hand damage in a small area in front of you. You deal damage in a larger area when you reach the target. The further you travel, the more damage you deal, and the greater your chance of stunning enemies.
templates.ShieldCrush: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap.
templates.ShieldCrushAltX: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap.
templates.ShieldOfLight: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of light in a cone in front of you. Additional waves will also emanate from allies in a radius around the first target struck, towards that target.
templates.ShieldShatter: Your shield shatters, dealing physical spell damage to enemies in an area, based on the shield's quality. For a short duration after this, you will be unable to block and will gain no defences from your shield, but your spells will deal added physical damage.
templates.ShockNova: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.
templates.ShockNovaAltX: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage. This then repeats, with each repeat offset from the previous in the direction you target.
templates.ShockwaveTotem: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around it, knocking back and damaging nearby enemies
templates.ShockwaveTotemAltX: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around you, damaging enemies.
templates.ShrapnelBallista: Summons a ballista totem that fires multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow.
templates.ShrapnelBallistaAltX: Summons a ballista totem that consumes your Steel Shards to fire multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.
templates.SiegeBallista: Summons a ballista totem that attacks with piercing arrows. Requires a Bow.
templates.SiegeBallistaAltX:
Summons a ballista totem that attacks with forking arrows.
Requires a Bow.
templates.SiegeBallistaAltY: Summons a ring of ballista totems around a targeted location. These ballistae fire once at the targeted location and then expire. Requires a Bow.
templates.SigilOfPower: Places a Sigil on the ground, which grants a buff to you and allies in the area around it for a duration. The Sigil gains stages as you spend mana in its area, making the buff more powerful. You can only have one Sigil of Power at a time.
templates.SignalPrey: Applies a debuff to a specific enemy which signals your minions to consider that enemy to be the Prey. All minions from skills supported by any Predator Support will target that enemy. Only one enemy can be the Prey at a time. This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.SiphoningTrap: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time. A beam is also applied to you, granting life and mana regeneration based on the number of debuff beams affecting enemies.
templates.SiphoningTrapAltX: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time.
templates.SkeletonArcherLightningArrow: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies.
templates.SkeletonBlackAbyssBoneLance: Fires a projectile that will pierce through enemies to impact the ground at the targeted location, creating a Bone Archer corpse where it lands.
templates.SkeletonCannonMortar: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.
templates.SkeletonSoldierTornadoShot: Fires a piercing shot that travels until it reaches the targeted location. It will then fire projectiles out in all directions from that point, which will travel for a short time before disappearing.
templates.SkeletonSpark: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.
templates.SkeletonVulnerability: Curse all targets in an area, causing them to take increased physical damage. Attacks against the cursed enemies have a chance to inflict bleeding.
templates.SlavedriverFlameWhip: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.
templates.Smite: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike a nearby enemy, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.SmiteAltX: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike nearby enemies, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
templates.SmokeMine: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
templates.Snipe: Channel to charge up your bow, gaining stages. Release to trigger one supported bow skill for each stage gained. If there are no supported skills, but at least one stage was gained, this skill will fire its own arrow instead. Cannot be used by Totems.
templates.SnipersMark: Curses a single enemy, increasing the damage they take from projectiles, and making projectiles split when hitting them, to hit other targets around them. You can only have one Mark at a time.
templates.SolarisChampionFlameVortex: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.
templates.SolartwineBlindingNova: When hit, release a nova of fiery vengeance, dealing spell fire damage and blinding enemies struck.
templates.SomaticShell: Fire a damaging projectile from your wand which aims itself towards an enemy and applies a shell to the first enemy struck. Damage from hits against that target is taken from the shell first. If fully depleted, the shell will explode, dealing area damage and firing a projectile at another target to apply a new shell to it. If multiple projectiles are fired by an exploding shell, only the first one to hit a target can apply a shell.
templates.SoulLink: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, your Energy Shield will intercept some of the damage they would take. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.Soulrend: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it, damaging and piercing through those it hits, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectile travels, it repeatedly applies a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it.
templates.SoulrendAltX: Fires a projectile that deals chaos damage to enemies it hits and leeches some of that damage as energy shield.
templates.SoulrendAltY: Fires a series of projectiles in a spiral that turn towards enemies in front of them, damaging and piercing through those they hit, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectiles travel, they repeatedly apply a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around them.
templates.Spark: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.
templates.SparkAltX: Launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.
templates.SparkAltY: Launches unpredictable sparks with that move randomly with large differences in speed and distance until they hit an enemy or expire.
templates.SpectralHelix: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls.
templates.SpectralHelixAltY: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.
templates.SpectralShieldThrow: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.
templates.SpectralShieldThrowAltX: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the evasion of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.
templates.SpectralShieldThrowAltY: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a piercing projectile which deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it reaches the targeted location it will hover in place, repeatedly firing a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. The rate at which it releases shards will increase until all shards have been fired. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.
templates.SpectralSkullShieldCharge: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled.
templates.SpectralSpirits: Summons three invulnerable spectral skulls that rush at nearby enemies and attack them rapidly. Enemies will not engage these spirits, and can pass through them.
templates.SpectralThrow: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then returns to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in its path.
templates.SpectralThrowAltX: Throws an intangible spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then becomes tangible as it returns to you, in a spinning attack that only hits and damages enemies while returning.
templates.SpectralThrowAltY: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires many spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out in all directions and then return to where the trap triggered, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.
templates.Spellslinger: Reserves mana based on the supported spells to cause those spells to trigger when you fire projectiles from a wand attack.
templates.SpiritBurst: Consumes a spirit charge to fire projectiles which deals physical damage.
templates.SpiritOffering: Consumes a corpse, granting increased critical strike chance and additional critical strike multiplier to your minions. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.
templates.SplitArrow: Fires multiple arrows at different targets.
templates.SplitArrowAltX: Fires an arrow that splits to hit different targets.
templates.SplittingSteel: Fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe.
templates.SplittingSteelAltX: Consume Steel Shards to fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.
templates.StalkingPustule: A corpse near the targeted location explodes, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
templates.StaticStrike: Attack with a melee weapon, gaining static energy for a duration if you hit an enemy. While you have static energy, you'll frequently hit a number of nearby enemies with beams, dealing attack damage.
templates.StaticStrikeAltX: Attack with a melee weapon, gaining a Gathering Lightning buff for a duration if you hit an enemy. While you have Gathering Lightning, attacks with this skill will cause chaining beams of lightning, which chain additional times the more Gathering Lightning you have.
templates.StormBrand: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing beams which deal damage to nearby enemies and those around them. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
templates.StormBrandAltX: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing a beam which deals damage to the branded enemy and those around it. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
templates.StormBurst: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump towards the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.
templates.StormBurstAltX: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump away from the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.
templates.StormCall: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it and causing lightning strikes at any other markers you've cast.
templates.StormCallAltX: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, a bolt strikes the marker, dealing physical damage around it and causing bolts to strike at any other markers you've cast. Bolt impacts will leave behind a pool of boiling blood, which deals physical damage over time to enemies within it for a secondary duration.
templates.StormCascadeTriggered: Lightning crackles in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.
templates.StormRain: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them.
templates.StormRainAltX: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to you, dealing area damage between the arrow and you.
templates.StormRainAltY: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them.
templates.Stormbind: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.
templates.StormbindAltX: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.
templates.StormblastMine: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated.
templates.SummonAbyssalConstructs: Summon two Bone Feeders which follow you around. Bone Feeders consume corpses they walk over, creating a temporary Aura after consuming 10 corpses. One Bone Feeder creates a Curse Aura of either Temporal Chains, Enfeeble or Punishment that ignores Curse Limits. The other Bone Feeder creates an Aura that causes Enemy Damage with Hits to be Unlucky.
templates.SummonArbalists: Summons Arbalist minions which use projectile attacks.
templates.SummonBeastialRhoa: Summons a Bestial Rhoa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Rhoa uses a charge and has an aura that intimidates enemies. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.
templates.SummonBeastialSnake: Summons a Bestial Snake. The Bestial Snake fires powerful chaos projectile attacks. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.
templates.SummonBeastialUrsa: Summons a Bestial Ursa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Ursa uses a powerful Ground Slam and Rallying Cry. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.
templates.SummonCarrionGolem: Summons a Carrion Golem that grants added physical damage for your non-golem minions. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.
templates.SummonCarrionGolemAltX: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes.
templates.SummonCarrionGolemAltY: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, can consume corpses to heal itself and gain the ability to unleash a devastating cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.
templates.SummonChaosGolem: Summons a Chaos Golem that grants you damage over time and chaos resistance. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.
templates.SummonChaosGolemAltX: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.
templates.SummonChaosGolemAltY: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a powerful damage over time Chaos aura that Withers enemies in addition to its melee attack.
templates.SummonDoedresEffigy: Summons an effigy of Doedre, which will project auras of all the curse skill gems socketed in Doedre's Skin. These curses have less effectiveness.
templates.SummonElementalRelic: Summons a Relic of a random element that stays near you. Depending on the element chosen, the relic minion will have an Anger, Hatred, or Wrath aura. These relics explode when they die, dealing elemental damage to enemies around them. If you already have a relic of the chosen element, its duration will be refreshed instead of summoning a new one.
templates.SummonFlameGolem: Summons a Flame Golem that grants you increased Damage and Area of Effect. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.
templates.SummonFlameGolemAltX: Summons a Flame Golem. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.
templates.SummonFlameGolemAltY: Summons a Flame Golem. When summoned, the Flame Golem attacks by falling from the sky, dealing fire damage in an area and leaving burning ground around the impact. After landing, it can cast a fire spray and a wave of fire damage.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfBrutality: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, and reducing the Damage you take.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfBrutalityUber: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, reducing the Damage you take, and causing Bleeding Enemies that you Kill to Explode, dealing 10% of their maximum Life as Physical Damage.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfDirections: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: 1 additional Projectile, +1 Chain, Pierce 1 additional Target, or Projectiles Fork.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfDirectionsUber: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: Fire 2 additional Projectiles, Chain 2 additional times, Projectiles Pierce 2 additional targets, or Projectiles Fork then Fork an additional time.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfFocus: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, and makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfFocusAscendancy: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments, and prevents Curses affecting you.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfFocusUber: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments, and prevents Curses affecting you.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfStorms: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfStormsUber: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock with increased effect to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfTheArcane: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally cast Arcane Surge on you, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfTheArcaneAscendancy: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion has two buff spells it will cast on you: Arcane Surge, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration, and a buff that grants Chance to Shock and Lightning Penetration.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfTheArcaneUber: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion has two buff spells it will cast on you: Arcane Surge, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration, and a buff that grants Chance to Shock and Lightning Penetration.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfTime: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you, and all allies and enemies near you.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfTimeAscendancy: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you and all allies near you.
templates.SummonHarbingerOfTimeUber: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you and all allies near you.
templates.SummonHolyRelic: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a nova spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies and grants life regeneration to allies in an area around it. This life regeneration is higher when applied to minions.
templates.SummonHolyRelicAltX: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies in an area around a nearby enemy.
templates.SummonIceGolem: Summons an Ice Golem that grants you increased Critical Strike Chance and Accuracy. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.
templates.SummonIceGolemAltX: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.
templates.SummonIceGolemAltY: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack. If reduced to low life it will trigger a spell that destroys itself to deal area damage and fire icy projectiles in a circle.
templates.SummonLightningGolem: Summons a Lightning Golem that grants you increased attack and cast speed, and mana regeneration. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.
templates.SummonLightningGolemAltX: Summons a Lightning Golem. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.
templates.SummonMirageChieftain: This skill is triggered when you use a Slam or Strike skill, and summons a Mirage Chieftain who will use that Slam or Strike skill once before dissipating.
templates.SummonRagingSpirit: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.
templates.SummonRagingSpiritAltX: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.
templates.SummonReaper: Summons a powerful Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack.
templates.SummonReaperAltX: Summons a Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The presence of any Reapers weakens your other non-Reaper minions, and Reapers will consume them to temporarily empower and heal themselves.
templates.SummonReaperAltY: Summons a powerful Reaper which passively follows you without attacking enemies. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack. Cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
templates.SummonSacredWisp: This skill is triggered by supported skills to summon Sacred Wisps which use the triggering skill when you do.
templates.SummonSentinelOfRadiance: Summons a Sentinel of Radiance which follows you and attacks enemies in melee, while burning enemies around it and taking a portion of damage from hits for you. You can only have one Sentinel of Radiance.
templates.SummonShaperApparition: Consume Remembrance to summon a memory of the Shaper, which will use a skill once before fading away.
templates.SummonSkeletons: Summon Skeleton Warrior minions at the targeted location. They use a melee attack and die after a duration. If made aggressive, Skeleton Warriors will also dash towards nearby enemies.
templates.SummonSkeletonsAltX: Summon Skeleton Archer minions at the targeted location. They fire arrows and die after a duration.
templates.SummonSkeletonsAltY: Summon Skeleton Mage minions of random elemental types at the targeted location. They cast projectile spells based on their element, and die after a duration.
templates.SummonSkitterbots: Summon a Chilling Skitterbot and a Shocking Skitterbot, which will trigger your traps and detonate your mines. Mines detonated by Skitterbots will re-arm and can then be detonated again. The Skitterbots grant you more trap and mine damage, and cannot be targeted or damaged.
templates.SummonSpectralTiger: Summons a Spectral Tiger Companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each Spectral Tiger grants you a buff that increases Critical Strike Chance, and increases Attack and Cast Speed. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.
templates.SummonSpectralWolf: Summons a spectral wolf companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each spectral wolf grants you a buff that adds damage to your attacks. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.
templates.SummonStoneGolem: Summons a Stone Golem that grants you life regeneration and defences. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.
templates.SummonStoneGolemAltX: Summons a Stone Golem. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.
templates.SummonStoneGolemAltY: Summons a Stone Golem that takes a portion of the melee damage you recieve from enemy hits from its life before yours. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.
templates.SummonTauntingContraption: Summons a Taunting Contraption that taunts nearby enemies to attack it.
templates.SummonVoidSpawn: Summon a Void Spawn minion, which casts a lightning projectile spell with a chance to shock enemies.
templates.SummonedLivingLightningZap: Jolt through an enemy, causing chaining Lightning Damage.
templates.SummonedReaperMelee: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.SummonedRhoaShieldCharge: Charges at a targeted location or enemy, pushing away enemies in your path and repeatedly dealing damage in a small area in front of you. You deal damage in a larger area when you reach the target. The further you travel, the more damage you deal, and the greater your chance of stunning enemies.
templates.SummonedSpiderViperStrike: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, will strike with both weapons. Requires a claw, dagger or sword.
templates.SumonRagingSpiritMelee: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
templates.Sunder: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.
